payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively checks all possible ways to partition the four bags between two friends by directly comparing sums: three 2-2 splits and four 1-3 splits. Outputs YES if any partition yields equal total candies, else NO.
payload.rationale: The code uses a fixed set of conditionals to try every possible assignment of bags, effectively performing a complete search over all subsets. No recursion or pruning is used, making bitmask enumeration the closest conceptual match.
